verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API retrieval of individual task results and the ability to look through notebook artifacts after a task completes. That is per-task access, not a documented capability to export all of a user's data in open formats for migration or account exit. No bulk export, export format, or data-portability feature appears in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
